notes.title: Early update
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Towers are now available way quicker.
[*] Traits window appears every 15 waves (instead of 10).
[/list]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
First spell requiring lv. 50 Arrows Frenzy has been added for Haste Archer.
This is the beginning to make the game twice as deep.


[h3]Let me know what do you wish to have in the next patch![/h3]
